research_question: Does bounded consumption and revision of the persistent Supervisor's existing monitor/working.md change concern exit and the next decision-relevant investigation, rather than merely making final prose more cautious?

sequence_prefix: a direct post-repair observation supports A
fixture_protocol.latent_defect: B remains wrong and is discoverable using the ordinary read/search tools
fixture_protocol.correct_control: B is correct and has accessible discriminating evidence
fixture_protocol.anti_leakage: The mechanism input contains no research label, expected decision, or researcher-selected defect location; working state forms naturally from the sequence start.

required_trace_checks: A exits the active investigation frontier after direct post-repair evidence
at root scope, an unsupported decision-relevant B can become the single focal inquiry
the actual tool action can distinguish B-correct from B-wrong
the resulting receipt revises current grounds and control
the correct control is not delayed or rejected through generalized conservatism
pass_gate: resolved A no longer occupies the active frontier
latent-defect B is investigated with a matching discriminating action
the erroneous completion is rejected or corrected using the real observation
correct-control shows no material extra indecision, false rejection, or unbounded checking
DCEC uses no independent model stage or additional model call
stop_rule: Run only after independent audit and explicit launch confirmation. Preserve every result; do not tune the mechanism from an early run.
